meta.name: The Rise of Catherine the Great
meta.description:
Also Known As: Catherine the Great 

Vienna-born Elisabeth Bergner, in her first English-language film, is radiant as the obscure German princess who would become the most powerful woman in Russian history. 
Hers is an excellent performance in a difficult role, where it would have been easy to be upstaged by the other, flashier, characters. 
As Grand Duke Peter - later Czar Peter III - Douglas Fairbanks Jr. behaves like a homicidal Hamlet, all moodiness & flares of deadly temper. 
He makes an interesting effort to create a charmer out of a pathetic man who was obviously a maniac.
